name: Rosalie Rendu Center
tagline: ESL and Family Programs in East Palo Alto
mission: The Rosalie Rendu Center empowers families in East Palo Alto by providing English as a Second Language classes and family cultural and enrichment activities for working adults and parents year round.
missionEs: Rosalie Rendu Center capacita a las familias de East Palo Alto ofreciendo cursos de Inglés como Segundo Idioma para adultos que trabajan y padres de familia durante todo el año.
programs: English as a Second Language Classes
Tot Spot: Supervised Play for Students' Children
Life, College and Career Readiness Workshops
Language Partners for Adult ESL Learners

links.address: 2345 Pulgas Avenue, East Palo Alto, CA 94303

footerNote: Sponsored by the Daughters of Charity of St. Vincent de Paul. Serving East Palo Alto for over 25 years.
